Description: IC USB PD SINK CONTROLLER ESSOP-10
Why not Digi-Key: Digi-Key does not carry WCH at all, and no pin-compatible ESSOP-10 PD sink exists there. STUSB4500 is QFN-24, AP33772 is QFN-14, HUSB238 has a different pinout - each is a schematic and layout respin, not a substitution. ~$0.39 ea.

Digi-Key stocks NO 1206 PPTC that holds 1A at 30V - their 1206 parts stop at 16V for 1.1A (1206L110/16WR), which is below the 20V PD rail and unsafe to fit. The only compliant Digi-Key part is Bourns MF-MSMF110/33X-2, which is 1812 and would force an F1 land-pattern change plus ~$9.20. Sourcing from LCSC keeps the 1206 footprint and costs cents.

Digi-Key's 3-position SMD DIP switches are tube-packed with a 60-piece minimum: CT2193MST-ND rejected the qty-12 order outright, and CT2193LPST-ND is MOQ 60 at $0.539 = ~$32 for parts worth ~$1. The only MOQ-1 alternative found (E-Switch KAS1103ET, $1.43) is through-hole, so it does not fit the SMD footprint anyway.
